name: osu-std-tracker
description: osu!standard live score tracker for players worldwide — rankings, a live score feed, and player/map profiles. Standalone Netlify site, sibling to the main osu-collection-hanabi site and to catch-tracker; see SETUP.md. Plain static frontend, no build step — actual function dependencies live in netlify/functions/package.json (installed by @netlify/plugin-functions-install-core, same as the other sites).
